change: Skip LZNT1 encoding when a lower bound on token and flag bytes excludes a smaller chunk.

confirmation.workload: Two distinct 16 MiB files generated by Random(797), uploaded and downloaded sequentially over one encrypted SMB 3.1.1 loopback connection with compression negotiated.
confirmation.timing: One warmup batch and one measured batch per process. File handles remain open. Setup, durable flush and byte comparisons against both SMB reads and backing files are outside the timer.
confirmation.plan: 12 randomized pairs, 24 distinct processes, seed 2903. Minimum elapsed-time reduction 5%, maximum process allocation increase 1 MiB per 64 MiB transferred. Family alpha 0.05 across two metrics.

volumeCheck.workload: Eight 64 MiB files per process. Four contain seeded random bytes, two repeat a 31-byte pattern, and two alternate 32 KiB of random and periodic data. Each file is uploaded, downloaded, flushed and independently verified. Each process first warms up on a separate 8 MiB file.
volumeCheck.measurement: Descriptive pooled payload bytes divided by elapsed transfer time. Each build transferred 2 GiB. Preparation, flush, close and validation are outside the timer.

validation: Full Release suite passed, including Windows native codec interoperability. Separate differential check produced identical complete encoded packets for 1,200 deterministic random, partially repetitive and periodic inputs from 64 to 65,648 bytes.
